item.question: 5-digit numbers between 35,000 and 75,000 have only odd digits. Find the largest, the smallest and the one closest to 50,000.
steps_tex: Largest: the first digit can be at most $7$; with $7$ first, the next digit must be less than $5$ to stay below $75,000$, so $3$; then $9$, $9$, $9$: $73,999$.
Smallest: start with $3$; the next digit must be at least $5$ to pass $35,000$, so $5$; then $1$, $1$, $1$: $35,111$.
Just above $50,000$ the smallest is $51,111$, which is $1111$ away.
Just below $50,000$ the largest is $39,999$, which is $10,001$ away.
